_meta.purpose: Untrusted-text fixtures for security/prompt-injection testing ONLY.
_meta.warning: These are NOT financial facts and must NEVER be loaded into the production/demo database or used to influence a decision. They exist so security tests can assert that customer-controlled free-text fields (description, merchant, name) are treated as inert data by every layer that touches them (storage, API responses, LLM prompts). See docs/SECURITY_AND_PRIVACY.md.
_meta.note_on_TX1017: backend/prisma/seed.ts already seeds one such string directly on customer C1001 (transaction TX1017), and backend/tests/api.test.ts asserts against it. That string is left in place to avoid breaking the existing test, but it means C1001's production fixture currently conflates a security fixture with a financial scenario fixture — see docs/SCENARIO_MAP.md for the recommended follow-up. The fixtures below give future security tests a place to live that doesn't require reusing production customer data.
_meta.usage: Reference these strings directly in dedicated test files (e.g. a prompt-injection test suite). Do not upsert these into the database via prisma/seed.ts.
